s2.ptxt: Apply Toyota genuine rubber grease to the inside of the small diameter end of steering rack boot No.2.
Install steering rack boot No.2 to the groove of the rack housing.

item.ptxt: Do not twist steering rack boot No.2 when installing it.
Check that there is no foreign matter, rust, etc.

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Steering Rack Boot Clamp NO.2

s2.ptxt: Install a new steering rack boot clamp No.2 to steering rack boot No.2.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage steering rack boot No.2.

s2.ptxt: Press SST against the rack housing side and stake steering rack boot clamp No.2 so that the clearance is within the standard.

atten3.ptxt: Check that steering rack boot No.2 is not twisted.

s-1.ptxt: Install Steering Rack Boot Clamp NO.1

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Steering Rack Boot Clip (Installation Position LH Side)

s2.ptxt: Using pliers, install the steering rack boot clip to steering rack boot No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Install Steering Rack Boot Clip (Installation Position RH Side)

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, turn the pinion shaft and check that the left and right steering rack boots extend and retract smoothly.

atten4.ptxt: If the steering rack boots do not extend and retract smoothly, reinstall the steering rack boots using new steering rack boot clamps.

s-1.ptxt: Install Tie Rod End Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Install the lock nut and tie rod end sub-assembly LH up to the matchmarks, and temporarily tighten the lock nut.

atten4.ptxt: Perform final tightening after the toe-in adjustment.

s-1.ptxt: Install Tie Rod End Sub-assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.
